context_quotes: We show that under our gating conditions, the charge transport below the metal-to-insulator-transition (MIT) temperature remains in the thermally activated regime, while the Seebeck coefficient exhibits an apparent transition from semiconducting to metallic behavior.
The contrasting behavior indicates changes in the electronic structure upon IL gating, due to the formation of oxygen defect states.
